english.title: Conspire to produce a controlled drug of Class A - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to produce

(E)_[**(..SPECIFY QUANTITY..)]_
(F)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY DRUG - NOT ONE LISTED IN NOTE (i) BELOW..) a controlled drug of class A in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(2)(a) of, and Schedule 4 to, the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired with person/persons
to produce
a Class A controlled drug - other

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) This offence wording should only be used for class A drugs NOT specifically categorised as follows - H2370 Cocaine, H2371 Heroin, H2372 LSD, H2373 MDMA (ecstasy), H2475 "Crack" cocaine and H2476 Methadone.

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence of seven years may apply to a third class A drug trafficking offence, see section 313 of the Sentencing Act 2020 and paragraph 1 of Schedule 2 to the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
